text.offer: My patrols in the Twisted Woods keep vanishing, and the trail always ends at the old cave in the west. There is an illusion sealing the orc caves beyond it - break it, go in, and remind the orcs whose land this is. Fifteen of their warriors, to start.
text.progress: The orc caves lie behind an illusionary wall in a cave west of Tos, in the Twisted Woods. You'll need to dispel the illusion to pass.
text.complete: Good. The patrols will sleep easier. But the orcs answer to something deeper in those caves, and I mean to find out what.

steps.brief: The orc wizards are the ones casting the glamours that hide their raiders. Kill ten of them.
